name: the-place
title: the place
blurb: one shared pixel canvas, no login — anyone can drop a pixel every few seconds, and everyone sees the same grid update. at 00:00 UTC today's canvas freezes forever and a blank one begins; every past day stays browsable. @minormobius.bsky.social's idea ("a bot that makes one website a day but it's like The Place and everybody's prompts make changes to the one big site for that day"), tagged in by @norvid-studies.bsky.social.
